environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with Postfix MTA running locally on port 25 in open-relay configuration (mynetworks = 127.0.0.0/8). No input validation middleware. Security groups allow outbound SMTP (port 25/587) to any destination. The service is exposed directly via the instance's public IP on port 8080 with no reverse proxy or WAF.

config.smtp: Postfix 3.5.8, open relay for localhost, outbound port 25 unrestricted
config.network: Security group: inbound 8080/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0, outbound all traffic allowed
